messages.content: Look, the index page has only dark mode, i want you to make light mode as well

## Found it: `index` page (`pages/bTGbC`) is dark-mode-only by design

I audited the page — it's the sign-in/reset-password screen. It has **no light-mode logic at all**: every background, input, button, divider, and several text labels use hardcoded dark RGBA values, and the page's `html_header` even forces `color-scheme: dark` globally with `!important` dark styling for native inputs/autofill.

The good news: the rest of the app (8,766 elements) already uses a proven pattern for this — each element gets a conditional **state** keyed on `Current User's dark_theme is_false`, overriding colors with the app's existing **paired light design tokens** (`styles/tokens.json` already defines a light counterpart for every dark token, e.g. `BG Secondary` ↔ `BG Secondary · Light`). I'll reuse that exact mechanism — no new tokens, no shared style-file edits (which would affect other pages).

## Plan (6 steps, savepoint + check before/after each)

| # | Step | Elements | Light-mode fix |
|---|------|----------|-----------------|
| 1 | Card & overlay backgrounds | `bUona` (Sign In card), `bUonN` (loading overlay) | bg/border/shadow → `BG Secondary/Primary · Light`, `Border Default · Light` |
| 2 | Input fields | Email (`bVDKK`), Password (`bUseQ0`) | bg/border/text/placeholder → `BG Tertiary · Light`, `Input Border · Light`, `Text Primary · Light`, `Text Muted · Light` |
| 3 | Ghost/icon buttons | Forgot-password (2), reveal-password eye, clear-email | border → `Border Default · Light`; icon/font → `Text Muted · Light` |
| 4 | Divider shapes | Shape B, Shape C | → `Border Default · Light` |
| 5 | Text labels | Title, subtitles, copy 2–5, subtitle, trademark, terms text | font_color → `Text Primary/Secondary/Muted · Light` (currently washed-out gray tokens that don't adapt) |
| 6 | Page `html_header` CSS | page-level | remove the forced `color-scheme: dark` + hardcoded dark input/autofill CSS, since inputs now control their own light/dark color via step 2 |

**Known minor limitation:** hover/click micro-states on the reveal-password icon (3 extra hover states) will stay dark-tinted in light mode — small cosmetic nit, low priority. I can fix it too if you want full polish.

Want me to go ahead with this, one step at a time (savepoint → apply → check after each)?

steps.label: Summarize elements on index page for theme audit
steps.body:
description: Summarize elements on index page for theme audit
command: python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, os

for f in sorted(glob.glob("pages/bTGbC/elements/**/element.json", recursive=True)):
    with open(f, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        d = json.load(fh)
    name = d.get("name") or d.get("default_name")
    etype = d.get("type")
    props = d.get("properties", {})
    style = props.get("style") or props.get("style_key")
    bg = {k:v for k,v in props.items() if "color" in k.lower() or "bgcolor" in k.lower()}
    has_state = "states" in d and "bptheme" in d.get("states", {})
    print(f"{f}\n  name={name} type={etype} style={style} has_bptheme_state={has_state}\n  colorprops={bg}\n")
EOF
